mapper.select: SELECT id, category_id, title, summary, dynasty, keywords, cover_image, heat FROM story WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY heat DESC
SELECT id, category_id, title, summary, dynasty, keywords, cover_image, heat FROM story WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

SELECT sua.story_id AS storyId, COUNT(*) AS actionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sua.action_type = 'like' THEN 3 WHEN sua.action_type = 'fav' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) AS weight FROM story_user_action sua WHERE sua.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY sua.story_id ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN action_type = 'view' THEN 1 END) AS viewCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN action_type = 'like' THEN 1 END) AS likeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN action_type = 'fav' THEN 1 END) AS favCount FROM story_user_action WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_user_action (user_id, story_id, action_type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{storyId}, #{actionType})
